blocks.text:
| Artifact | Role | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `proofpress.py` | Proofpress CLI and protocol implementation | persistent implementation; linked as `execution/proofpress.py` |
| `research/knowledge_handoff_debt/run_r2_two_state_diagnostic.py` | two-state knowledge-handoff runner | completed local mechanism study |
| `research/knowledge_handoff_debt/run_phase2_track2.py` | Track 2 runner | completed local study |
| `research/apex_direct/run_apex_direct.py` and associated runners | controlled clean/outdated admission studies | completed local studies; exact variants indexed by the experiment docs |
| `docs/KNOWLEDGE_HANDOFF_DEBT_PLAN.md` | registered knowledge-handoff protocol | completed design record with later result cross-links |
| `docs/LOCAL_EXPERIMENT_RESULTS.md` | complete result inventory and failure appendix | current synthesis |
| `docs/RESULTS_MATRIX.md` | result matrices and interpretation rules | current synthesis |
| `pp_eval/` and `tests/test_eval.py` | earlier mechanism runtime and tests | historical/internal tooling |
| `suites/*.json` | local technical fixtures | local fixtures; redistribution status must be checked before release |

This ARA points to code in the surrounding experiment repository instead of copying independent implementations into the package. Before public release, these pointers must be converted to stable repository-relative links at a tagged commit, and the derived task bundle must receive an explicit redistribution manifest. Historical STALE, Harvey, and transport experiments remain part of the failure appendix, not the main empirical claim.
